name: secret-guard
description: Blocks API keys, tokens and passwords from reaching files, commands, commits or prompts, and shows only a masked rule and location when it does.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses the action when a secret is found; warn only shows a loud warning and lets it through (useful for a trial period).

guardFiles.title: Guard file writes and edits
guardFiles.description: Scan what the Write, Edit and NotebookEdit tools are about to put in a file.

guardCommands.title: Guard shell commands
guardCommands.description: Scan the text of Bash and PowerShell commands before they run.

guardCommits.title: Guard git add and git commit
guardCommits.description: Before git add or git commit runs, scan the changes it would stage or commit.

guardPrompts.title: Guard your prompts
guardPrompts.description: Scan the prompts you type, and the files you name with @, before they are sent to the model.
